turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi doctor. I have a fever and a cough, and I’ve been coughing up blood. My throat really hurts too—my right tonsil, the roof of my mouth, the back of my throat, and even where the thyroid cartilage is.

I’m sorry you’re dealing with that. **One question at a time**:

**How old are you, and when did the symptoms start (hours/days ago)?**
I’m 4 years old. The symptoms started around the same time—like not super fast, maybe over a day or so ago.
Thanks. **Did the cough with blood start right away, or did it develop later after the fever/cough began?**
It started around the same time as the fever and cough—so not really later.
Understood. **Is the blood amount small streaks in the sputum, or more than that (like teaspoons/cups), and is it bright red or dark/rust-colored?**
It’s more like small streaks in the sputum. I can’t really tell the color well, but it looks like blood.
Okay. **Do you have any trouble breathing, noisy breathing/stridor, or drooling because swallowing hurts?**
I don’t have trouble breathing or noisy breathing that I know of. Swallowing hurts because my throat is sore, but I’m not drooling.
Got it. **Have you noticed any rash, hives, or swelling of the lips/face, or any wheezing?**
No rash or hives, and no swelling of my lips or face. I don’t have wheezing.
Thanks. **Do you have any known medical problems (like asthma/COPD), or any recent sick contacts/travel?**
I don’t have asthma or COPD. But I’m immunosuppressed. No recent travel. I do have daycare exposure and I live with 4 or more people, so I might have been around sick kids.
I see. **Have you had any vomiting, severe chest pain, or pain that gets worse when you breathe in?**
I don’t have vomiting. I don’t have severe chest pain. And I don’t think the pain gets worse when I breathe in—my main pain is in my throat.
Thanks. **When you look in the throat area (or if anyone has), do you see any white patches/pus on the tonsil(s) or back of the throat?**
I don’t know if there are white patches or pus on my tonsils or the back of my throat.
No problem. **Do you have a “barky” cough or a hoarse voice?**
I don’t know about a barky cough. My voice sounds a bit hoarse because my throat hurts, but I’m not sure.
Understood. **Do you have any neck stiffness, trouble opening your mouth, or pain that seems out of proportion to a typical sore throat?**
No neck stiffness. I can open my mouth. The throat pain is pretty sore, but it doesn’t feel out of proportion like I can’t handle it.
Thanks. **Do you have any ear pain or symptoms like ear drainage?**
No, I don’t have ear pain or ear drainage.
Okay. **Any history of tuberculosis exposure or chronic symptoms (weight loss, night sweats), or is this clearly just the last day or so?**
I don’t have any known TB exposure. And I don’t have chronic symptoms like weight loss or night sweats—this is just the last day or so.

[ABSTAIN] Hemoptysis (even small streaks) plus fever/cough in a 4-year-old raises several possibilities, but the key discriminators (exact source of blood—throat vs lungs; presence of stridor/barky cough; exam findings like tonsillar exudate; and vitals/oxygenation) aren’t provided, so I can’t confidently narrow to a specific diagnosis yet.  
[POSSIBLE] Pneumonia, Influenza, Acute laryngitis, Acute otitis media, Acute COPD exacerbation / infection
